title: Node protocol version not supported
message: Node {node_id} speaks protocol version {version}; this daemon supports {supported_versions}.
basic_text: This computer runs a version of Rastai that can't talk to yours.
fix_text: Update Rastai on both computers.

title: Daemon key not paired with this node
message: This daemon's key is not paired with node {node_id}.
basic_text: This computer hasn't been paired with your Rastai.
fix_text: Pair the node again.

title: A node is already running on this machine
message: A node is already running on this machine (process {pid}).
basic_text: Rastai's node service is already running here.
fix_text: Use the running node, or stop it first.

title: The node lacks a capability this job needs
message: Node {node_id} lacks the capability {capability} that this job needs.
basic_text: This computer can't run this kind of task.
fix_text: Pick another node, or update this one.

title: Node, transfer or Hugging Face command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: An identity key or the pinned-keys file can't be used
message: The identity file {path} can't be used: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't read or save this computer's identity key.
fix_text: Make sure the file belongs to you and only you can read it (chmod 600). If it is damaged, move it aside and pair this computer again.

title: Handshake refused: its challenge is stale or was used before
message: The handshake from {daemon_id} was refused: {reason}.
basic_text: Your Rastai and this computer couldn't confirm each other.
fix_text: Check that the clocks of both computers are right, then connect again.

title: No such node
message: No node {node_id} is known to this daemon.
basic_text: Rastai doesn't know this computer.
fix_text: Refresh the node list and pick a node from it.

title: Node call without a valid session token
message: A {service} call was refused: it carried no session token of the current handshake.
basic_text: Rastai and this computer lost track of their connection.
fix_text: Wait a moment: the connection is made again on its own. If it keeps happening, restart Rastai.

title: SSH authentication failed
message: SSH authentication to {host} failed.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't log in to that computer.
fix_text: Check your SSH key and user name for this host.

title: SSH host key changed; refused
message: The SSH host key of {host} changed; the connection is refused.
basic_text: That computer's identity changed since last time, so Rastai won't connect. This can mean an attack.
fix_text: If the host was reinstalled, remove its old key from known_hosts and confirm the new fingerprint.

title: Unknown SSH host key; confirm the fingerprint
message: The SSH host key of {host} is unknown: {fingerprint}.
basic_text: Rastai hasn't connected to this computer before.
fix_text: Check the fingerprint with the host's owner, then confirm it.

title: Remote OS or CPU architecture not supported
message: {host} runs {os} on {architecture}, which Rastai doesn't support.
basic_text: Rastai can't run on that computer.
fix_text: Use a host whose system Rastai supports; the install guide lists them.

title: Linger unavailable; the node stops when you log out
message: Linger is unavailable on {host}; the node stops when you log out.
basic_text: Rastai on that computer stops when you log out of it.
fix_text: Ask the host's admin to enable linger for your user (loginctl enable-linger).

title: ssh binary not found
message: The ssh binary {ssh_binary} was not found.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't find the SSH program on this computer.
fix_text: Install OpenSSH, or set nodes.ssh_binary to its path.

title: Rastai isn't installed on the host
message: Rastai isn't installed on {host}.
basic_text: Rastai isn't installed on that computer yet.
fix_text: Install Rastai on the host, then pair it again.

title: SSH connection timed out or the host is unreachable
message: The SSH connection to {host} timed out, or the host is unreachable.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't reach that computer.
fix_text: Check the host name, the network and that the computer is on.

title: No free local port for the tunnel
message: No free local port for the tunnel to {host}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't find a free network port for the connection.
fix_text: Close programs that use many ports, then try again.

title: Node unreachable
message: Node {node_id} missed {missed_heartbeats} heartbeats and is unreachable.
basic_text: Rastai lost contact with that computer.
fix_text: Check that the computer is on and connected.

title: Connection to the node dropped; its streams ended
message: The connection to node {node_id} dropped; its streams ended.
basic_text: The connection to that computer dropped. Its tasks keep running and reconnect.

title: Node reconnected; jobs reattached
message: Node {node_id} reconnected; its jobs were reattached.
basic_text: The connection to that computer is back.

title: Local socket not reachable
message: Nothing is listening at the local socket {path}.
basic_text: The Rastai service this needs isn't running.
fix_text: Start Rastai, or the node, and try again.

title: Socket folder isn't private; refused
message: The socket folder {path} is owned by another user, open to group or others, or not a folder; it is refused.
basic_text: Rastai's folder for local connections could be reached by another user, so Rastai won't use it.
fix_text: Remove the folder; Rastai creates it again so only you can open it.

title: The peer of a local socket is another user; connection refused
message: The local socket {path} is held by another user; the connection is refused.
basic_text: Another user's program answered on Rastai's local connection, so Rastai refused it.
fix_text: Stop the other user's program, or use a runtime folder only you can open.

title: Local socket can't be created
message: The local socket {path} can't be created: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't open its local connection.
fix_text: Stop the other Rastai that is running, or remove the file in the way, then try again.

title: Local connection failed or timed out mid-request
message: The local connection at {path} failed or timed out mid-request: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai lost its local connection while working.
fix_text: Try again. If it keeps failing, restart Rastai.

title: Local sockets aren't supported on this platform yet
message: Local sockets aren't supported on {platform} yet.
basic_text: This part of Rastai doesn't work on this computer's system yet.

title: Transfer path outside the allowed folders
message: The path {path} is outside the allowed folders.
basic_text: Rastai won't copy files to or from that folder.
fix_text: Pick a file inside Rastai's data or project folders.

title: Transfer chunk at the wrong offset
message: A transfer chunk arrived at offset {offset}; expected {expected_offset}.
basic_text: A file copy got out of step.
fix_text: Try the transfer again.

title: Transferred file hash mismatch
message: The transferred file {path} doesn't match its hash.
basic_text: A copied file arrived damaged.
fix_text: Try the transfer again.

title: Model repository or file not found
message: {repository} or its file {file_name} was not found.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't find that model online.
fix_text: Check the model's name and spelling.

title: Gated model: license not accepted or no access
message: {repository} is gated: its license isn't accepted, or this account has no access.
basic_text: This model needs you to accept its license first.
fix_text: Accept the license on the model's Hugging Face page, then try again.

title: Offline mode: download refused
message: Offline mode is on, so the download of {repository} is refused.
basic_text: Rastai is set to work offline, so it won't download anything.
fix_text: Turn off hf.offline to download.

title: Hugging Face token missing or rejected
message: The Hugging Face token is missing or was rejected.
basic_text: Rastai needs your Hugging Face access token for this.
fix_text: Sign in to Hugging Face in Rastai again.

title: Outbound HTTPS request without an egress tag
message: An outbound HTTPS request to {host} had no egress tag; it was refused.
basic_text: Rastai blocked a network request that wasn't labeled. This is a bug.
fix_text: Please report this bug; the log has the details.

title: Download interrupted; retries used up
message: The download of {file_name} was interrupted and its retries are used up; it can resume.
basic_text: The download stopped and couldn't restart by itself. What was downloaded is kept.
fix_text: Check your connection, then start the download again to resume it.

title: Waiting for another program's download of this file
message: Waiting for another program's download of {file_name}.
basic_text: Another program is downloading the same file, so Rastai is waiting for it.

title: Another program held this file's download lock for 10 minutes
message: Another program held the download lock of {file_name} for 10 minutes.
basic_text: Another program has been downloading this file for a long time.
fix_text: Check whether the other download is stuck, then try again.

title: Transfer cancelled; partial file kept
message: The transfer of {file_name} was cancelled; the partial file is kept.
basic_text: The copy was cancelled. What was copied is kept so it can resume.

title: Redirect refused: no target, or more than 5 hops
message: The download of {file_name} was refused a redirect: {reason}.
basic_text: The server sent the file to an address Rastai won't follow. Trying again gets the same answer, so the download stopped at once.

title: Update signature or hash invalid
message: The update's signature or hash is invalid; nothing was installed.
basic_text: The update didn't pass its security check, so Rastai didn't install it.
fix_text: Try the update again later.

title: Update download failed
message: The update download failed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't download the update.
fix_text: Check your connection and try again.

title: Update would make installed plugins incompatible
message: Updating to {version} would make these plugins incompatible: {plugin_ids}.
basic_text: This update would stop some of your plugins from working.
fix_text: Update those plugins first, or update anyway and turn them back on later.

title: Update waiting for running jobs
message: The update waits for {job_count} running jobs to finish.
basic_text: Rastai will update once its running tasks finish.

title: The new version failed its health check; the previous version was restored
message: Version {version} failed its health check; the previous version was restored.
basic_text: The update didn't work, so Rastai went back to the version you had.
fix_text: Report the problem with a bundle.
